Ukraine protests erupt after Defence Minister's dismissal

Protests have broken out in Ukraine following the dismissal of Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov. Demonstrators gathered in Kyiv, calling for his return and expressing dissent. President Zelenskyy acknowledged disputes within the military leadership, appointing an acting defence minister amidst the unrest.
